rows.text: The Secretary-General lays on the Table (11 March 1991) a letter dated 6 March 1991 from the Prime Minister to the President tendering his own resignation and that of his Council of Ministers (Library No. LT-2215/91).

locator.item: Resignation of Council of Ministers, paper (1)

rows.text: Also laid on 11 March 1991: a letter dated 6 March 1991 from the President to the Prime Minister accepting his resignation and the resignation of his colleagues from the Council of Ministers (Library No. LT-2216/91).

locator.item: Resignation of Council of Ministers, paper (2)

rows.text: The same letter of 6 March 1991 requests the Prime Minister to continue in office till a new Government is formed.

locator.item: Resignation of Council of Ministers, paper (2): 'requesting him to continue in Office till a new Government is formed'

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only.
